name: core.openwop.workflows.marketing
description: Real-work workflow pack (RFC 0013, ADR 0149) — the Marketing & Advertising cluster: Full Campaign Launch, Ad Performance Optimization Loop, Content Brief Generator, and Content Repurposing. Reasons with core.ai.chatCompletion over real tenant data (feature.crm / feature.kb / feature.cms / feature.email); reads/optimizes the ad platforms provider-agnostically via the core.openwop.connectors.ad-* capability nodes (Meta or Google, whichever the tenant connected — ADR 0186). The optimization loop routes within-guardrail changes to auto-apply and out-of-guardrail changes to a core.chat.approvalGate via a core.flow.if conditional node (ADR 0149 open-question resolution: a flow conditional, not a new primitive). Every launch/publish/apply is approval- or guardrail-gated; all tenant values are run parameters (replay-deterministic). Published under core.openwop.workflows.* (openwop-team key).
author: openwop

chains.label: Full Campaign Launch
chains.description: From a brief: select the audience (CRM), draft ad copy and creative, reference the landing page (CMS), consolidate for review, then launch on the ad platform after approval.

orgId.description: The CRM/CMS org id to read the audience + landing page from.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: Write ad copy variants for the campaign brief: {{params.brief}}
Propose creative concepts/variants for the campaign brief: {{params.brief}}

config.title: Approve launching this campaign on the ad platform

chains.label: Ad Performance Optimization Loop
chains.description: Read ad metrics from whichever platform the tenant connected (provider-agnostic core.openwop.connectors.ad-metrics — Meta or Google, not hard-coded), diagnose anomalies and recommend a bid/budget shift, then a core.flow.if guardrail routes within-guardrail changes straight to a budget recommendation and out-of-guardrail changes through approval first — finally log the learnings. Budget changes are RECOMMENDED by default (the ad-budget-update node dry-runs unless you set config.dryRun:false); a deliberate opt-in applies the change live via ctx.ads.updateBudget behind the same guardrail + approval gate (ADR 0186 slice 4b). Pair with an hourly scheduled trigger.

guardrail.description: The auto-apply guardrail; changes beyond it require approval.

platform.description: Ad platform to read/optimize (meta | google | tiktok) — whichever the tenant connected.

adAccountId.description: The ad account id on the platform.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

config.systemPrompt: Detect anomalies vs thresholds and recommend a bid/budget shift. State whether the change is within the guardrail ({{params.guardrail}}). End with a line 'WITHIN GUARDRAIL: yes' or 'WITHIN GUARDRAIL: no'.
